notes.title: Voxel Tanks OST Retiring
notes.content: Hello everyone! Unfortunately, we are forced to remove the Voxel Tanks OST from the store in the near future. Thanks to everyone who supported us and who appreciated this part of the game :)

notes.title: Witchcrafty upcoming!
notes.content:
Witchcrafty is a metroidvania-platformer that immerses you in a world of magic. Everything you expect from a fairy game, but with a touch of weirdness. A little witch with an unhealthy craving for explosions. Suspicious magic cat. Giant mushrooms trying to kick you.
Stay in touch and add game to wishlist, so you won't miss demo and game release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122280/Witchcrafty/

notes.title: WARRABBIT UPDATE
notes.content:
Good news, evereyone!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830122/b1525a3eb2ef9c213c85ba6b4d5621dff20a190d.png[/img]

Here come the first Voxel Tanks update - WARRABBIT! Command your tank, destroy enemies and try not to be destroyed by giant war mechs! You are the warrabbit! You have paws, soft ears and 120mm tank gun!

+ new enemies
+ new levels
+ new achievements
+ bugfixes (at 8 lvl, yes)
+ new bugs (probably)

notes.title: Voxel Tanks OST!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830122/d578a4e242c066e27e065c15118d9e89627eabf5.png[/img]

Good news, everyone! 

I want to inform you, that the soundtrack to our favorite game (Voxel Tanks, if you forgot) is new available on Steam! Dozen of awesome chiptune tracks, that can blow up your mind when you blowing up your enemies!

P.S. Please, blow up your enemies only in videogames.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/897310/Voxel_Tanks_OST/
